beat: Dhika withdraws, ends visit, then next-day Skype rings during shower

lines.original: Dhika: (  Opening her eyes... she took and kept her legs down in a jerk)... Bantu dear... thanks for the help.. she smiled....
lines.local: Dhika ne aankhein kholkar jhatke se taange neeche rakh di: Bantu dear, madad ke liye thanks. Woh muskuraayi.

lines.original: Dhika: Its getting late dear... I have to go pick up Pappu from aunty's... so I will see you online on Friday ?
lines.local: Dhika: Der ho rahi hai dear, Pappu ko aunty ke ghar se lene jaana hai. Friday ko online milenge?

lines.original: Bantu: feeling a little caught,... he too stood up... uhnn, yeah, yes miss... its getting late...and miss... I will not be available from tomorrow till next Monday... but Bobby will be available coming Friday... you please teach him and I will learn from him miss...
lines.local: Bantu ko laga woh pakda gaya; woh bhi khada hua: Haan miss, der ho rahi hai. Main kal se next Monday tak available nahi rahunga, Friday Bobby hoga. Aap use padha dena, main usse seekh lunga.

lines.original: Saying this...he said bye and he proceeded to leave... Dhika thanked him for coming and gave him a sweet kiss on his cheeks.
lines.local: Bye bolkar woh jaane laga; Dhika ne aane ke liye thanks kaha aur uske gaal par ek sweet kiss di.

lines.original: After he left... she put on some pain reliever and went to aunty's.... she chatted with aunty for a while and then she and Pappu came back and waited for John, watching Tv...
lines.local: Uske jaane ke baad Dhika ne pain reliever lagaaya, aunty ke ghar gayi, thodi baat ki aur Pappu ko lekar aayi. Dono TV dekhte John ka wait karne lage.

lines.original: Later, she also called Bobby and apologized for her behavior earlier, explaining what happened, and promised no matter what happens... she will never get angry or show it towards them.
lines.local: Baad mein Dhika ne Bobby ko phone karke pehle ke behavior ke liye maafi maangi, sab samjhaaya, aur wada kiya ki jo bhi ho ab un par gussa nahi dikhaayegi.

lines.original: She heard Skype ring in her laptop, while she was in the shower......
lines.local: Dhika shower mein thi tab uske laptop par Skype ki ring baji.

lines.original: Dhika: Who is calling at this time ?.....
lines.local: Dhika: Is waqt kaun call kar raha hai?

lines.original: Only a few people called her in Skype
lines.local: Skype par use bahut kam log call karte the.

lines.original: John if he is on trip
Her or His parents when they want to see Pappu
lines.local: Uske ya John ke parents, jab Pappu ko dekhna chahte.

lines.original: She let it ring as she was showering still..... It was only 11 AM in the morning... John left to work early as usual but it was a holiday for her... Pappu was at aunty's house playing with another neighbor kid...
lines.local: Woh naha rahi thi toh ring bajne di. Subah ke sirf 11 baje the; John usual tarah jaldi kaam par chala gaya tha, Dhika ki holiday thi aur Pappu aunty ke ghar pados ke bacche ke saath khel raha tha.

lines.original: She almost finished showering when it rang again.... she quickly turned off the water and started drying her off to go and see who it was..... but she was late and the call disconnected....
lines.local: Nahaana lagbhag khatam hua tab phir ring baji. Usne jaldi paani band kiya, khud ko pochha aur caller dekhne nikalne lagi, par tab tak call cut ho gayi.
